activity_summary: At home you kept his sentence and yours. The story is a living if it holds. Yours was Navarre, a blank quire, and fivepence that did not touch the coffer. Nobody had spoken with a man off the ship. The scarf was off. The jaw was not.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Repeated the day's sentence, and did not write on the quire.

facets.activity: Said the story was a living, and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It's a living. His, if the story holds.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Little riches. I asked, and nobody had spoken with a man off the ship.
